senses.gloss:
दल् दल् (connected with rt. दॄ), cl. 1.
P. दलति, ददाल, अदालीत्, दलितुम्, to
burst open, split, crack, to be divided, to fly open,
open in chinks, open (as a bud or blossom), expand,
blossom: Caus. दलयति and दालयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to burst, to split or tear or open, tear asunder; to
cut, divide, split, pierce; to wither; [cf. Lith. dalis,
‘a part;’ dallykas, ‘a fragment;’ daliyu, ‘to
divide:’ Goth. dails, ‘a part:’ Old Germ. tail,
teil; tīlōn, tīligōn = Caus. दलयामि: Lat. dolo:
Hib. dail, ‘a share;’ dailim, ‘I deal out;’ duil,
‘partition;’ duillean, ‘a spear.’]

दल, अम्, n. (according to lexicographers also
अस्, m.), a piece torn or split off; a part, a portion,
a fragment, a rent, side [cf. अष्ट-दल]; a degree;
[]
a half, the half (e. g. अहर्-दल, mid-day); a sheath,
scabbard; a small shoot, blade, petal, leaf (i. e. what
unfolds itself; often occurring at the end of names
of plants, the fem. being दला; cf. उदुम्बर-द्˚,
कर्कश-द्˚, काम-खड्ग-द्˚, क्षार-द्˚); the blade
of anything (as of a knife &c.); a clump, lump, heap,
quantity; a detachment, body of men; dividing,
tearing, cutting, splitting, &c.; an adulteration or
alloy; (अस्), m., N. of a prince; (ई), f., see दलि
below; [cf. Hib. duille, ‘a leaf.’]
—दल-कपाट, अस्,
m. a folded petal or leaf.
—दल-कोमल = कमल,
the lotus (Nelumbium).
—दल-कोष, अस्, m. ‘hav-
ing young shoots incased in sheaths,’ a sort of jasmine
(J. Pubescens).
—दल-ज, अम्, n. ‘produced by
small bees’ or ‘produced from young shoots,’ a kind
of honey; [cf. दाल.]
—दल-तरु, उस्, m. = ताडी,
a kind of palm, Corypha Taliera.
—दल-निर्मोक,
अस्, m. a kind of birch (lit. ‘leaf-shedding’), the
bark of which is used for hookahs &c. (= भूर्ज-
पत्त्र).
—दल-पति, इस्, m., N. of a prince.
—दल-
पुष्पा, ई, f. a fragrant plant, the leaves of which
surround the flower, Pandanus Odoratissimus (= के-
तकी).
—दल-मालिनी, f. a kind of cabbage.
—दल-
शस्, ind. in pieces or fragments (e. g. दलशो या, to
go or fall to pieces).
—दल-शालिनी, f. a species of
pot-herb (= कञ्चुक-शाक).
—दल-सायसी (?), f.
white basil.
—दल-सारिणी, f. = केमुक, a species
of pot-herb, (probably) = दल-शालिनी.
—दल-सूचि,
इस्, m. a thorn.
—दल-स्नसा, f. the fibre or vein of a
leaf.
—दलाख्य (˚ल-आख्˚), अस्, m., N. of a parti-
cular constellation (subdivisions of which are Ahi and
Mālā).
—दलाग्र-लोहित, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a sort of spinage.
—दलाढक (˚ल-आढ्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of several plants, Pistia Stratiotes (= पृश्नी);
a kind of jasmine (= कुन्द); wild sesamum;
Mesua Ferrea (commonly Nageśar); Acacia Sirissa
(= शिरीष); red chalk (= गौरिक); foam (=
फेन); cuttle-fish bone; a moat, a ditch; a Śūdra;
the head man of a village (?), the driver of an ele-
phant (?); an elephant's ear; a hurricane, a high
wind.
—दलाढ्य (˚ल-आढ्˚), अस्, m. mud, espe-
cially on the banks of a river; [cf. दलाढक.]
—दलामल (˚ल-अम्˚), अम्, n., N. of several
plants, = दमनक and मरुवक; Vangueria
Spinosa and Artemisia.
—दलाम्ल (˚ल-अम्˚), अम्,
n. sorrel.
—दली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, divided, bisected,
halved.
—दले-गन्धि, इस्, m. (‘fragrance in the
leaf’), N. of a plant, Echites Scholaris; [cf. सप्त-
पर्ण.]
—दलोद्भव (˚ल-उद्˚), अम्, n. a kind
of honey; [cf. दल-ज and दाल.]

दाल दाल, अम्, n. a sort of wild or unpre-
pared honey, (according to some produced by a pecu-
liar kind of small bee; see दल-ज); (आ), f. = दालिका,
देव-दालिका, colocynth; (ई), f. a kind of plant, =
देव-दाली; (अस्), m. a sort of grain, = Paspalum
Frumentaceum.

दलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, splitting, bursting open,
rending; being torn or cut.
—दलद्-धृदय, अस्,
आ, अम् (दलत् + हृदय), broken-hearted, cut to the
heart, &c.

दलन, अस्, ई, अम्, splitting, tearing asunder or
in two, breaking to pieces, cutting, dividing; (ई), f.
a clod of earth [cf. दलि]; (अम्), n. bursting; tear-
ing, rending, breaking, crushing, cutting to pieces,
grinding.

दालन दालन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. दल्), crum-
bling or decay (of the teeth), tooth-ache.
दालन; for ‘अम्, n.’ read अस्, m.

दलनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken or destroyed
or trodden down.

दलि, इस्, f. (according to some also दली), a clod
of clay or earth; [cf. दलनी and दलन.]
दलिक, अम्, n. timber, a piece of wood.

दालिका दालिका, f. = दाला, देव-दालिका,
colocynth.

दलित, अस्, आ, अम्, burst, split, broken, torn,
rent; torn asunder, cut to pieces, wounded; opened,
unfolded, expanded, blown, full blown; divided in
two, bisected, halved; divided into degrees, distri-
buted; driven asunder, scattered; trodden down;
crushed; destroyed; manifested.
दलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having pieces, leaves, &c.

दल्मि, इस्, m. Indra's thunderbolt; an epithet of
Indra; [cf. दर्म, दर्मिन्, दाल्मि.]
—दल्मि-
मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a thunderbolt.

दाल्मि दाल्मि, इस्, m., N. of Indra; [cf.
दल्मि.]

दलप दलप, अस्, m. a weapon; a sacred
or religious book (= शास्त्र for शस्त्र); gold.

दल्भ दल्भ, अस्, m. a wheel; fraud, dis-
honesty, sin; N. of a Ṛṣi; [cf. Hib. dalbh,
‘falsehood.’]

दाल्भ दाल्भ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दाल्भ्य below),
relating to or coming from Dālbhya.
दल्भ्य, अस्, m., N. of an ancient preceptor.

दाल्भ्य, अस्, m. (fr. दल्भ), a patronymic of
Keśin; of Caikitāyana; N. of a grammarian.
—दाल्-
भ्य-घोष, अस्, m., N. of an ancient sage.
—दाल्-
भ्य-परिशिष्ट, अम्, n., N. of a poetical work.

दालकि दालकि, इस्, m., N. of a pupil of
Śaka-pūrṇi.

दालभ्य दालभ्य, a wrong form for Dāl-
bhya, q. v.
दालव दालव, अस्, m. a sort of poison.

दालिम दालिम, अस्, m. the pomegranate;
[cf. दाडिम.]
दाल्भि, इस्, m. (fr. दल्भ), a patronymic of Vaka.
दाल्भ्यक, अस्, m., N. of an ancient sage.

दाल्मायणि दाल्मायणि, probably a wrong
form for दाल्भायनि or दार्भायणि.
